props.title: The Westin Westminster
props.lede: The Westin Westminster has over 100,000 sq ft of event space off US 36, between Denver and Boulder, with three ballrooms and a string of courtyards, gardens and terraces outside them.

headingText.html: It hosts big conferences, company parties and weddings, including Indian weddings, which the hotel plans for.

props.title: Live music in each Westin Westminster event space
props.lede: Here’s the act we’d pick for each space. Press play to hear it over the photo.

spaces.name: Waterfall Gardens and the courtyards
spaces.facts: The Waterfall Gardens are about 19,800 sq ft outdoors, for receptions of up to 400. The North and South courtyards hold receptions of up to 350 and 400.
spaces.why: A solo violin to a full string quartet, from the ceremony through dinner.
spaces.alt: The Waterfall Gardens, with stepped rock and plantings below the hotel.

spaces.name: Westminster Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Westminster Ballroom is about 11,900 sq ft with 22-foot ceilings, for banquets of up to 840 and receptions of up to 1,200. It divides into four sections.
spaces.why: A six-piece band playing 90s and 2000s R&B and hip-hop, for when you want everyone dancing.
spaces.alt: The Westminster Ballroom set with round tables before a wall of windows at dusk.

spaces.name: Legacy and Standley ballrooms
spaces.facts: The Legacy Ballroom is about 9,600 sq ft, for banquets of up to 675 and receptions of up to 960. The Standley Ballroom is about 4,600 sq ft, for banquets of up to 320 and receptions of up to 500.
spaces.why: Rock covers everyone knows, with a powerhouse singer out front.
spaces.alt: The empty Legacy Ballroom with windows along two walls.

spaces.name: The Lake House
spaces.facts: The Lake House is about 3,300 sq ft, for banquets of up to 200 and receptions of up to 250.
spaces.why: He can start as a duo and grow to a full band over the evening.
spaces.alt: The Lake House set with round tables beside a stone fireplace and tall windows.

spaces.name: Sunset Rooftop Deck
spaces.facts: The Sunset Rooftop Deck is about 2,700 sq ft, for banquets of up to 110 and receptions of up to 140.
spaces.why: Flamenco and rumba on Spanish guitar, for a cocktail hour or a dinner.

props.title: Planning music at the Westin Westminster

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel also has AV in-house.
We plan load-in and setup with the hotel’s events team.
The gardens, courtyards and rooftop are outdoors, so we’ll plan the music with an indoor backup in mind.

props.html: Questions to ask the Westin Westminster events team

items.html: Which spaces have an end time for amplified music, and when is it?
Does the hotel’s AV team need to connect or run the band’s sound, and is there a fee for that?
Where do vendors load in, and when can the band set up?
Is there power near where the band will play?
What wording do you need on the certificate of insurance?

props.html: Forward this list to the events team, or send us the answers and we’ll plan around them.
Questions about music at the Westin Westminster

items.q: Can we bring our own band to a wedding at the Westin Westminster?
items.a: Hotels like the Westin Westminster generally let you book your own entertainment, within their rules on insurance, load-in and sound. Your event manager can confirm them for your date, and we send a certificate of insurance with every booking.

items.q: Does the band need the hotel’s AV team?
items.a: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel’s AV team can add anything beyond that, and we’ll work out the details with your event manager.

items.q: Can one act play the ceremony, the cocktail hour and the reception?
items.a: Yes. The same act can move with you from The Sunset Rooftop Deck to The Westminster Ballroom, and one booking covers all of it.

items.q: How much does live music add to a wedding at the Westin Westminster?
items.a: It depends on the size of the act and how much of the day it covers. Our pricing page has what live music costs in the Colorado market, and we’ll send a quote for your date.
